[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

'HIT' is coded as '132'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e0353df591bc7cf8e1142a51aae59269694bdbdc920e8dea5f7a84cc6fe93f1.png]

'SBYZ' is coded as '144'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9e8ea6c198fba8f398bd970bc7c96f3c1575aacf2204320ea27eb447b5e3827.png]

'YRF' is coded as
